admissible_if: at least two provisionally eligible 3-year windows exist
at least one non-overlapping eligible-window pair exists
site_key_selection.selection: choose the first admissible key in the frozen priority order

temporal_window_selection.eligible_input: rows in three_year_window_candidates.csv with eligible_provisional=true for the selected site key
temporal_window_selection.pilot_rule: among eligible windows that have at least one later non-overlapping eligible window, choose the smallest start_year; tie-break smallest end_year
temporal_window_selection.confirmatory_rule: among eligible windows non-overlapping and later than the selected pilot, choose the largest end_year; tie-break largest start_year

window_specific_sampling_universe.eligible_islands: exact island_names reported by the Event-only audit for the selected window
window_specific_sampling_universe.core_sites: selected-key sites with at least one Event row in each of the three years of the selected window
window_specific_sampling_universe.surveyed_zero_future_rule: a taxon may be zero-filled for an island-year only after future response routing is restricted to the frozen core sites and the island-year satisfies the already-frozen Event completeness rule

pilot_confirmatory_roles.burned_pilot: earliest selected three-year window; may be used only for endpoint quality and estimability
pilot_confirmatory_roles.confirmatory: latest non-overlapping selected three-year window; occurrence extension remains sealed until taxon universe, response routing, endpoint and scoring are fully frozen

taxonomic_boundary.Araneae: exclude from primary unless the previously declared companion-dataset crosswalk is frozen before any occurrence parse
